purpose: Aggregates batch settlement data into CSDR/T+1-relevant KPIs: settlement rate, fail rate, total CSDR penalty cost, on-time allocation rate, SSI golden-source coverage, buy-in triggered count, and fail-duration distribution. Benchmarks against ESMA annual settlement-efficiency statistics (~97.5% EU average).
